inlines.v: RESPI'RE, verb intransitive [Latin respiro; re and spiro, to breathe.] 1. To breathe; to inhale air into the lungs and exhale it, for the purpose of maintaining animal life. 2. To catch breath. 3. To rest; to take rest from toil. RESPI'RE, verb transitive To exhale; to breathe out; to send out in exhalations.
